facts.fact: The Kenya School of Government launched its eLearning and Information Technology Institute (eLITI) as 1,239 public officers graduated from the UNESCO-Oxford Programme on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in Government, per Tech Africa News.
facts.system: UNESCO-Oxford Programme on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in Government

facts.fact: The Kenya School of Government's eLITI, built on the eLearning and Development Institute, brings together digital learning and ICT training for public officers, and 1,239 public officers completed its UNESCO-Oxford AI programme, per Tech Africa News.
